福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・東區

臺南文化創意產業園區（B16）Tainan Cultural & Creative Park

走出台南火車站前站右轉，走一分鐘就到。一棟紅磚建築立起，背後正是香格里拉飯店的玻璃高樓。在地人用門牌號碼叫它，像個登機門的名字：B16。這棟紅樓始於 1901 年，是臺灣總督府專賣局的臺南出張所。專賣局管的是最賺錢的生意，菸與酒為最。1947 年改為臺灣省菸酒公賣局臺南分局，負責配銷香菸與米酒。2003 年，這座老出張所被指定為市定古蹟。2015 年重新開門成為文創園區，是五大文創園區中第一個交由大學營運的。當年堆菸箱的地方，如今是展覽、市集、講座與手作課。在 B16 月臺上，親子和鐵道迷一起看火車。

Turn right out of Tainan Station and walk for one minute. A red-brick building rises, with the glass tower of the Shangri-La hotel right behind it. Locals call the place by its address, like a boarding gate: B16. The red building began in 1901 as a Tainan office of the Japanese Monopoly Bureau. The Monopoly Bureau controlled the most profitable goods, tobacco and liquor above all. In 1947, it became the Tainan office of the Taiwan Tobacco and Wine Monopoly Bureau, rationing out cigarettes and rice wine. In 2003, the old office was listed as a municipal monument. In 2015, it reopened as a creative park, the first of the five flagship parks run by a university. Exhibitions, maker markets, lectures, and craft classes fill the spaces where tobacco crates once stacked. From the B16 platform, families and railfans watch the trains go by.

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

臺南文化創意產業園區（B16）就在台南火車站旁。紅磚樓始於日治時期的專賣局台南出張所，管的是菸與酒；如今老倉庫變成展覽、市集與講座的空間，月臺旁還能看火車。

The Tainan Cultural & Creative Park, known as B16, is one minute from Tainan Station. Its red-brick building began as a government monopoly office for tobacco and alcohol, and its warehouses now host shows, markets and talks.

  1. 1901臺灣總督府專賣局臺南出張所。The Tainan office of the government monopoly bureau opens.
  2. 1947改為臺灣省菸酒公賣局臺南分局，配銷香菸與米酒。It becomes the Tainan branch of the tobacco and wine bureau.
  3. 2003指定為市定古蹟。It is listed as a city monument.
  4. 2015重新開放為文創園區，交由大學營運。It reopens as a creative park run by a university.

認識景點

About the place

專賣：只有一個單位能賣某種商品。專賣局掌管菸和酒。 專賣局：掌管殖民地最賺錢商品的政府機關。 菸草：葉子用來做香菸的植物，是專賣局的主要商品之一。 米酒：用米釀的酒。1947 年後，這裡配銷米酒和香菸。

monopoly: When only one group may sell a product. The Monopoly Bureau controlled tobacco and liquor. the Monopoly Bureau: The government agency that controlled the colony's most profitable goods. tobacco: A plant whose leaves are used to make cigarettes. It was one of the bureau's main goods. rice wine: A liquor made from rice. After 1947, this office rationed it out with cigarettes.

倉庫：存放貨物的大建築。這些倉庫以前堆滿菸箱。 展覽：公開展示作品或物品。如今舊空間裡辦的是展覽。 月臺：鐵軌旁的高台。B16 月臺正對著鐵道。 市定古蹟：由城市保護的歷史建築。老出張所在 2003 年成為市定古蹟。

warehouse: A big building for storing goods. Tobacco crates once stacked in these warehouses. exhibition: A public show of art or objects. Exhibitions now fill the old spaces. platform: A raised place next to train tracks. The B16 platform looks straight onto the railway. municipal monument: A historic building protected by the city. The old office became one in 2003.

手作市集：販賣自己手作商品的市集。現在園區常有市集。 鐵道迷：喜歡火車的人。鐵道迷帶著相機來月臺。 時刻表：火車到站和開車時間的表。園區還立了火車時刻告示板。 配給、配銷：有限量地分配東西。這裡曾配銷菸和酒。

maker market: A market where people sell things they make. Maker markets fill the park today. railfan: A person who loves trains. Railfans come to the platform with cameras. timetable: A list of the times trains arrive and leave. The park even posted a train timetable board. ration: To give out a limited amount of something. This office rationed out tobacco and wine.

發酵：酵母把糖變成酒精和氣體，就是發酵；冒泡代表正在進行。 酵母：一種微小的生物。酵母吃糖，產生酒精和二氧化碳。 蒸餾：把液體加熱成蒸氣，再冷卻變回液體。米酒是蒸餾出來的。 釀酒廠：釀造啤酒的工廠。公賣局的酒廠生產臺灣啤酒。

ferment: When yeast turns sugar into alcohol and gas, the mix ferments. Bubbles show it is working. yeast: A tiny living thing. Yeast eats sugar and makes alcohol and carbon dioxide. distill: To heat a liquid into vapor, then cool the vapor back into a liquid. Rice wine is distilled. brewery: A factory where beer is brewed. The bureau made Taiwan Beer in its breweries.

瓶子、裝瓶：裝飲料的玻璃容器。最後一步是裝瓶、貼標籤。

bottle: A glass container for drinks. The last step is to fill the bottle and add a label.

實景照片

Photos on site

專賣局臺南出張所 The old monopoly office

園區的主角是這棟紅磚長屋：日治時期專賣局的臺南出張所，管理菸和酒的買賣。屋頂鋪日式黑瓦，兩端山牆上有放射狀的白色裝飾，正中央是白色的門廊，右後方就是香格里拉飯店的玻璃高樓。

The star of the park is this long red-brick building, the Tainan office of the Japanese-era monopoly bureau that controlled tobacco and alcohol. It has a dark tiled roof, sunburst decorations on the end gables and a white porch in the middle. The glass tower behind is the Shangri-La hotel.

白色門廊 The white porch

正門是一座白色的希臘式門廊，上方是三角形的山牆，兩邊各有一個圓形裝飾。綠色窗框的拱窗一扇扇排開，現在屋內是一家咖啡店。

The main door sits in a white porch with a triangular top and two round decorations, in a Greek style. Arched windows with green frames line the walls. Today a coffee shop is inside.

拱窗與紅磚牆 Arched windows

側面的紅磚牆上，每扇窗頂都用磚砌成弧形拱，窗下是白色的窗台。屋簷下一排小方孔是通風口，讓屋內保持乾燥，適合存放菸草。

On the side wall, each window has a curved brick arch on top and a white sill below. The row of small square holes under the roof lets air through, keeping the rooms dry for storing tobacco.

紅磚屋圍起的中庭 The courtyard

往裡走，幾棟紅磚屋圍出一個安靜的中庭，屋前有木柱撐起的走廊，草地上鋪著石板步道，樹下有石桌石椅可以休息。

Further in, several brick buildings surround a quiet courtyard. Wooden posts hold up covered walkways, stone paths cross the lawn, and there are stone tables under the trees.

中庭的石碑 The courtyard garden

紅磚屋圍起的中庭裡，有一條石板小徑，盡頭是一座用鵝卵石砌起的小丘，上面立著一塊石碑。木柱撐起的走廊沿著紅磚屋繞一圈，綠色的門窗很顯眼。

In the courtyard, a stone path leads to a small mound of river stones with a stone tablet on top. A covered walkway on wooden posts runs around the brick buildings, with bright green doors and windows.

紅磚長屋與飯店高樓 Old brick and a new tower

另一棟紅磚長屋，屋頂鋪著日式黑瓦，綠色窗框的拱窗一字排開，門口加了木造的無障礙坡道。左後方是香格里拉飯店的玻璃高樓，新舊建築就這樣並排站在一起。

Another long brick building has a dark tiled roof and a row of arched windows with green frames. A wooden ramp now leads to the door. Behind it rises the glass tower of the Shangri-La hotel, old and new side by side.

園區後段的大樓 The newer buildings

往園區裡面走，是後來加蓋的大樓。牆上的大型彩繪寫著這裡現在的用途：流行音樂與數位文創、假日市集和場地租借；外掛的鋼構樓梯通往各層的工作室和展覽空間。

Further in stand the newer, larger buildings. The big mural lists what happens here today: pop music and digital creative work, weekend markets and event spaces. Steel stairs on the outside lead up to studios and galleries.

老倉庫變展場 From warehouse to gallery

當年堆放菸酒的倉庫，紅磚牆配上鐵皮屋頂，屋頂上加了通風的氣樓。現在這裡是展覽空間，常換不同的展覽。

The old warehouses, with brick walls and metal roofs topped by air vents, once held boxes of tobacco and wine. Now they are galleries with changing exhibitions.

B16 旁的鐵道 Tracks beside the park

園區就緊貼著鐵道。從圍籬邊看過去，舊枕木堆在軌道旁，遠方是臺南車站的月臺雨棚。這一段鐵路正在進行地下化工程，眼前的地面軌道將來會走入歷史。

The park sits right next to the railway. Old wooden sleepers lie beside the tracks, with the platform roofs of Tainan Station in the distance. The line here is being moved underground, so these surface tracks will one day be gone.

軌道另一頭 Across the tracks

軌道對面的白色新建築，是鐵路地下化的新設施；後方的黃色高樓是成大宿舍。

Across the tracks, the new white buildings belong to the underground railway project. The tall yellow buildings behind are NCKU student dormitories.
